verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud sandbox platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and a dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry opt-out, usage-tracking controls or a privacy setting. Network egress policies and encrypted secrets are adjacent security features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
